articles.summary: Running code and seeing output is not yet a test. A test compares an observed result with a stated expectation. Make the expectation precise enough that a plausible mistake would fail it.
body: Running code and seeing output is not yet a test. A test compares an observed result with a stated expectation. Make the expectation precise enough that a plausible mistake would fail it.
